children: HSBC maintains its neutral month-ahead conviction for U.S. Treasurys, U.S. rates strategist Dhiraj Narula says in a note. HSBC finds the current selloff to be increasingly stretched, he says. "But with renewed geopolitical risks and a very much 'live' September FOMC meeting, yield levels could remain choppy in the coming weeks," he says. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
